unit.why: A short anecdote: R. Nahum of Chernobyl, a guest in Ovruch, perceives the thoughts the shochet had while slaughtering his fowl, and the shochet confirms it.
unit.boundary_note: Numbered example (ג) inside a thematic section on the shochet ('מענין שוחט'); next division resumes the teaching material.

stories.start_quote: כמו שאירע להק׳ ר׳ נחום מטשערנאביל ז"ל
stories.summary_en: While lodging in Ovruch, R. Nahum of Chernobyl senses from the fowl served to him that its shochet had been thinking of a feared official during the slaughter, and the shochet admits it.
